title: Card levels — every Settings menu, before and after

steps.headline: Backup & Sync: keep the card levels?
steps.changed: Every first-level card is the same glass card; everything inside a card shares one nested look; no full-width lines; text that belongs to a card sits inside it; outlined buttons are visible.
steps.notice: Same groups in the same places as today.
